data_tooling.name: Rocket.Chat
data_tooling.summary: Rocket.Chat 是一个基于 Meteor 和 TypeScript 构建的开源、可自托管的实时通信平台，专为高安全性与数据主权需求设计。它支持端到端加密、通过 Matrix 协议实现联邦通信，并提供丰富应用与集成接口以深度定制工作流。与专有工具不同，它允许完全控制数据，可部署于本地或私有云以满足合规要求。平台支持频道、私信、文件共享、WebRTC 音视频通话及多渠道客服（如网站聊天、WhatsApp 集成）。核心优势在于开源透明、可扩展性强，适合政府、金融等安全敏感场景。可利用其API开发自定义机器人以自
data_tooling.summary_en: Rocket.Chat is an open-source, self-hosted communication platform designed for organizations needing secure, real-time messaging. Built with Meteor and TypeScript, it supports end-to-end encryption, federated messaging via Matrix, and extensive customization through apps and integrations. Unlike proprietary tools, it gives full data control and can be deployed on-premises or in private clouds. Use it to build a compliant, mission-critical collaboration hub for teams, with features like omnichannel support, file sharing, and WebRTC video calls.

framework_core.name: Unciv
framework_core.summary: Unciv 是一款基于 Kotlin 和 LibGDX 框架的开源《文明 V》复刻版，支持 Android 和桌面平台。它完整还原了经典的 4X 策略玩法——探索、扩张、开发、征服——并以简洁的像素风格呈现。技术亮点在于展示了如何利用跨平台框架将复杂的回合制策略游戏移植到移动端，同时保持流畅体验。你可以直接安装游玩，或 fork 代码研究游戏 AI 逻辑、修改规则模组，甚至参与社区贡献。对于想学习游戏开发或随时来一局文明的玩家，Unciv 是绝佳的开源参考。
framework_core.summary_en: Unciv is an open-source remake of Civilization V for Android and desktop, built with Kotlin and LibGDX. It faithfully recreates the classic 4X strategy experience—explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate—with a clean, pixel-art interface. Technically, it demonstrates how to port a complex turn-based game to mobile using cross-platform frameworks. You can play it on Android or desktop, fork the code to study game AI or mod the rules, or contribute to its active community. Perfect for learning game development or enjoying Civ on the go.

framework_core.name: OpenMontage
framework_core.summary: OpenMontage是全球首个开源智能体视频制作系统，可将AI编程助手（如Cursor、Copilot）转化为完整视频工作室。系统通过12条流水线、52个工具及500余项智能体技能，自动完成脚本撰写、配音、图像生成与剪辑。其核心技术为模块化智能体框架，大语言模型（如Claude、GPT）借助结构化提示词协调专用工具，实现端到端视频创作。用户可集成至现有编码助手或独立运行，仅需输入文字即可生成视频，适用于快速原型制作、教育内容或社交媒体短视频，显著降低视频制作门槛。
framework_core.summary_en: OpenMontage is the first open-source agentic video production system that transforms AI coding assistants into full video studios. It orchestrates 12 pipelines, 52 tools, and 500+ agent skills to automate tasks like scriptwriting, voiceover, image generation, and editing. Technically, it uses a modular agent framework where LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT) coordinate specialized tools via structured prompts. You can integrate it with Cursor or Copilot, or run it standalone to produce videos from simple text prompts. Ideal for rapid prototyping, educational content, or social media videos.

framework_core.name: rlm
framework_core.summary: rlm是一个通用的即插即用推理库，专为递归语言模型（RLM）设计，解决了递归模型部署复杂的问题。其核心技术亮点是支持多种沙箱环境，使得模型在递归推理循环中能够安全、灵活地执行。通过rlm，开发者可以轻松实验RLM的多步推理和自我修正能力，只需简单集成到现有Python项目中即可。无论是研究递归模型的推理机制，还是构建需要迭代思考的应用，rlm都提供了高效的工具。
framework_core.summary_en: rlm is a general plug-and-play inference library for Recursive Language Models (RLMs), simplifying the deployment of models that iterate over their own outputs for enhanced reasoning. Its key technical insight is supporting multiple sandbox environments, allowing safe and flexible execution of recursive inference loops. Practically, you can use rlm to experiment with RLMs for tasks like multi-step reasoning or self-correction, integrating it into existing Python projects with minimal setup.

ui_devex.name: continue
ui_devex.summary: Continue 是一个开源编码代理，将 AI 直接嵌入你的 IDE，让你在不离开编辑器的情况下完成代码生成、重构和调试。其核心优势在于模块化架构：支持 GPT-4、Claude 及本地模型等多种 LLM 后端，并通过可定制的代理循环实现上下文感知的代码转换。你可以用它自动化重复性任务、快速理解陌生代码库，或通过插件系统构建专属的 AI 工作流。例如，配置一个自动添加单元测试的代理，或让 AI 在审查 PR 时提供修改建议。
ui_devex.summary_en: Continue is an open-source coding agent that integrates AI into your IDE, helping you generate, refactor, and debug code without leaving your editor. It leverages a modular architecture supporting multiple LLM backends (e.g., GPT-4, Claude, local models) and provides a customizable agent loop for context-aware code transformations. You can use it to automate repetitive tasks, explore codebases, or build custom AI-powered workflows by extending its plugin system.

ui_devex.name: Unciv
ui_devex.summary: Unciv 是一款基于 Kotlin 和 LibGDX 框架的开源《文明 V》复刻版，支持 Android 和桌面平台。它完整还原了经典的 4X 策略玩法——探索、扩张、开发、征服——并以简洁的像素风格呈现。技术亮点在于展示了如何利用跨平台框架将复杂的回合制策略游戏移植到移动端，同时保持流畅体验。你可以直接安装游玩，或 fork 代码研究游戏 AI 逻辑、修改规则模组，甚至参与社区贡献。对于想学习游戏开发或随时来一局文明的玩家，Unciv 是绝佳的开源参考。
ui_devex.summary_en: Unciv is an open-source remake of Civilization V for Android and desktop, built with Kotlin and LibGDX. It faithfully recreates the classic 4X strategy experience—explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate—with a clean, pixel-art interface. Technically, it demonstrates how to port a complex turn-based game to mobile using cross-platform frameworks. You can play it on Android or desktop, fork the code to study game AI or mod the rules, or contribute to its active community. Perfect for learning game development or enjoying Civ on the go.

ui_devex.name: OpenMontage
ui_devex.summary: OpenMontage是全球首个开源智能体视频制作系统，可将AI编程助手（如Cursor、Copilot）转化为完整视频工作室。系统通过12条流水线、52个工具及500余项智能体技能，自动完成脚本撰写、配音、图像生成与剪辑。其核心技术为模块化智能体框架，大语言模型（如Claude、GPT）借助结构化提示词协调专用工具，实现端到端视频创作。用户可集成至现有编码助手或独立运行，仅需输入文字即可生成视频，适用于快速原型制作、教育内容或社交媒体短视频，显著降低视频制作门槛。
ui_devex.summary_en: OpenMontage is the first open-source agentic video production system that transforms AI coding assistants into full video studios. It orchestrates 12 pipelines, 52 tools, and 500+ agent skills to automate tasks like scriptwriting, voiceover, image generation, and editing. Technically, it uses a modular agent framework where LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT) coordinate specialized tools via structured prompts. You can integrate it with Cursor or Copilot, or run it standalone to produce videos from simple text prompts. Ideal for rapid prototyping, educational content, or social media videos.

ui_devex.name: codebase-memory-mcp
ui_devex.summary: Codebase Memory MCP 是一个高性能代码智能 MCP 服务器，能将整个代码库索引为持久化的知识图谱，实现毫秒级代码理解。其核心技术在于使用自定义 AST 解析器与图数据库，将代码结构转化为可查询的图数据，查询速度低于毫秒，同时为 LLM 上下文减少 99% 的 token 消耗。你可以将其集成到 Claude Code、Cursor 等开发工具中，获得即时、上下文感知的代码辅助，无需重复索引。该工具支持 158 种编程语言，单静态二进制文件无依赖，适合大型项目快速导航与智能问答。
ui_devex.summary_en: Codebase Memory MCP is a high-performance server that indexes entire codebases into a persistent knowledge graph, enabling instant code understanding. Its key innovation is using a custom AST parser and graph database to achieve sub-millisecond queries while reducing token usage by 99% for LLM context. You can integrate it with tools like Claude Code or Cursor to get instant, context-aware code assistance without re-indexing.

You can integrate it with tools like Claude Code or Cursor to get instant, context-aware code assistance without re-indexing.
edge_embedded.summary_zh: Codebase Memory MCP 是一个高性能代码智能 MCP 服务器，能将整个代码库索引为持久化的知识图谱，实现毫秒级代码理解。其核心技术在于使用自定义 AST 解析器与图数据库，将代码结构转化为可查询的图数据，查询速度低于毫秒，同时为 LLM 上下文减少 99% 的 token 消耗。你可以将其集成到 Claude Code、Cursor 等开发工具中，获得即时、上下文感知的代码辅助，无需重复索引。该工具支持 158 种编程语言，单静态二进制文件无依赖，适合大型项目快速导航与智能问答。

deployment_serving.name: rlm
deployment_serving.summary: rlm是一个通用的即插即用推理库，专为递归语言模型（RLM）设计，解决了递归模型部署复杂的问题。其核心技术亮点是支持多种沙箱环境，使得模型在递归推理循环中能够安全、灵活地执行。通过rlm，开发者可以轻松实验RLM的多步推理和自我修正能力，只需简单集成到现有Python项目中即可。无论是研究递归模型的推理机制，还是构建需要迭代思考的应用，rlm都提供了高效的工具。
deployment_serving.summary_en: rlm is a general plug-and-play inference library for Recursive Language Models (RLMs), simplifying the deployment of models that iterate over their own outputs for enhanced reasoning. Its key technical insight is supporting multiple sandbox environments, allowing safe and flexible execution of recursive inference loops. Practically, you can use rlm to experiment with RLMs for tasks like multi-step reasoning or self-correction, integrating it into existing Python projects with minimal setup.
